caption: The drawing consists of a series of abstract shapes arranged within a grid format, divided into several rectangular and square sections. The background of each section is a sandy beige color. At the top, there are five small rectangles featuring red and black line drawings: the first shows concentric circles with wavy, radiating edges; the second, a central red orb with multiple curved lines protruding outward; the third, a spiky, circular red shape reminiscent of a sun; the fourth, a thick black and red abstract form with concentric circular and amoeboid patterns; and the fifth, a red form with a central stem and rounded ends, outlined in black. Directly below, the leftmost section contains a simple vertical red shape with cross lines at the top and bottom, and the middle left section has two black and red, eye-like forms with protruding short lines on their upper edges. The large center-right section displays an arrangement of red outlined shapes, some elongated, others circular or abstract, grouped together in a loose vertical cluster with some elements suggesting limb-like appendages. At the bottom right within this section, there is a small black semi-circular form with lines inside. All the objects are drawn with uneven, hand-drawn lines, predominantly in red, with a few using black as secondary color, and the composition is spread over a tan textured paper backdrop with wide, even white margins surrounding the entire arrangement.
title: Petroglyph
